experiments.name: optimize-translation-pipeline-bcdf
experiments.goal: Implement B(parallel pages) + D(cache) + F(pipelined stages) + E(local model compat) optimization. Reduce 28-bubble page from 16min to 2-3min.

design_decisions.three_parallel_modes: serial (current default), parallel (concurrent pages), pipelined (stage overlap across pages)
design_decisions.concurrency_config: ProjectConfig.pipeline_concurrency field, default 5 for parallel mode
design_decisions.cache_backend: SQLite via stdlib sqlite3 (no new deps), keyed by (source_text_hash, stage, target_lang, provider_model)
design_decisions.pipeline_async: asyncio event loop with ThreadPoolExecutor for LLM calls, pages stream through stages
design_decisions.local_model_compat: configurable max_workers per provider type, local providers get higher concurrency

risk_areas: memory updater has sequential dependencies between pages (character state updates)
SQLite write contention under parallel writes
ProviderCascade is not thread-safe (creates new provider per call already, so OK)
experiments.verification: Test 3 high-res manga pages, compare serial vs parallel vs pipelined execution time

failures.root_cause: ProjectConfig.translation_config defaults to {parallel_mode: parallel}. Orchestrator reads translation_config.get(parallel_mode) which returns parallel, ignoring the top-level parallel_mode=serial attribute.
feed_pages sends concurrency=2 sentinel Nones, but each stage_worker only propagates 1 sentinel and breaks. Second None stuck in queue[0]. Final queue gets 1 sentinel but drain expects 2.

blocked_by: Config precedence bug: translation_config default overrides serial mode

issues.title: Architecture deviation: ProjectConfig missing standalone fields
issues.description: Plan specified independent fields (parallel_mode, pipeline_concurrency, etc.) on ProjectConfig. Implementation uses incomplete translation_config dict instead.
issues.root_cause: Pydantic extra='ignore' silently drops all unrecognized fields. translation_config dict was intended as passthrough but lacks the required keys.
issues.fix: Add parallel_mode, pipeline_concurrency, cache_enabled, max_workers as standalone fields on ProjectConfig model.

issues.title: Wrong default: parallel_mode defaults to 'parallel' instead of 'serial'
issues.description: Plan requires serial as default behavior. Current default 'parallel' changes production behavior without explicit opt-in.
issues.root_cause: translation_config defaults to {parallel_mode: 'parallel'} and orchestrator reads via .get() which returns the dict default before checking the model attribute.
issues.fix: Default parallel_mode to 'serial'. Change orchestrator to read from ProjectConfig.parallel_mode field directly.

issues.title: Deadlock: pipelined mode hangs due to incomplete sentinel propagation
issues.description: feed_pages sends N sentinel Nones (one per concurrency slot), but each stage_worker only propagates 1 sentinel then breaks. Remaining sentinels stuck in queue. Final drain waits forever.
issues.root_cause: stage_worker has 'break' after first None propagation, should propagate all N sentinels matching concurrency level.
issues.fix: stage_worker must forward all sentinels received (count matching concurrency parameter) before exiting.

root_causes: Pydantic extra='ignore' config silently drops unrecognized fields at ProjectConfig construction time
translation_config default dict fills all keys, so .get() never falls through to model attribute
build_project_config() **pipeline_settings spread is ineffective because fields don't exist on ProjectConfig
stage_worker breaks after first sentinel instead of forwarding all N sentinels for concurrency slots

fix_options.name: Add standalone fields to ProjectConfig
fix_options.description: Add parallel_mode, pipeline_concurrency, cache_enabled, max_workers as explicit Pydantic fields. Update build_project_config() and orchestrator to use them directly.
fix_options.pros: Follows original plan. Clean, explicit. No dict magic.
fix_options.cons: More fields on ProjectConfig. Requires updating config loader.

fix_options.name: Fix translation_config dict approach
fix_options.description: Remove defaults from translation_config dict. Fix orchestrator to check model attribute first, fall through to dict. Fix sentinel propagation in pipelined mode.
fix_options.pros: Less model surface change. Keeps dict flexibility.
fix_options.cons: Implicit precedence. Harder to discover config options. Still violates plan.

round_1_review.next_steps: Choose option A or B, implement fix, re-run full test suite.

issues.title: LLMCache not integrated into translation_stage.py
issues.description: LLMCache class is fully implemented (19/19 tests pass) and PipelineContext has llm_cache field, but TranslationStage._call_semantic_llm() and _call_persona_llm() never check or store cache entries. The 'D' in BCDF (cache optimization) is dead code.
issues.root_cause: TranslationStage methods call provider_cascade.call_chat() directly without wrapping with cache lookup/store. The cache is initialized in orchestrator.run() and passed via context.llm_cache but never consumed.
issues.fix: Add cache check before LLM call and cache store after LLM call in both methods. Cache key: source_text + stage ('semantic_translation' or 'persona_render') + target_lang + model.
issues.impact: Without this, repeated translations of same text hit LLM every time. BCDF core optimization (D=cache) completely non-functional.

issues.title: test_translation_stage_parallel.py incompatible with extra='forbid'
issues.description: 7 tests in test_translation_stage_parallel.py pass translation={} to ProjectConfig constructor. ProjectConfig uses extra='forbid' and only has translation_config field, not translation. All 7 tests fail with ValidationError.
issues.root_cause: Test file was written before ProjectConfig was refactored with standalone fields. The translation dict was the old approach; translation_config is the new field name.
issues.fix: Replace translation={} with translation_config={} in all 7 test fixtures.
issues.impact: 7 test failures in CI. These tests cover semantic-parallel mode which is not yet implemented in translation_stage.py.

issues.title: Phase 4 (local model compatibility) not implemented
issues.description: The plan includes local model optimization (configurable max_workers per provider type). ProjectConfig has translation_max_workers field but it's only used in orchestrator ThreadPoolExecutor creation, not wired to local provider detection.
issues.fix: Deferred to future iteration. Not blocking cache integration.

issues.title: Parallel mode does not truly parallelize page translation
issues.description: _execute_stage_parallel_pages() delegates to stage.execute() which processes pages sequentially. The parallel mode only creates a ThreadPoolExecutor but doesn't dispatch pages to it.
issues.fix: Deferred to future iteration. TranslationStage internally handles some parallelism via sequential bubble processing.
